defects.where: content/listen/cpe-bach-flute-concerto-g-presto.mjs: opening and closing cues, section notes, transition evidence and orchestra.timeline; dossier score/version locators
defects.problem: The flute’s claimed opening and closing rests are inferred from a blank staff in a shorthand working manuscript. A blank staff does not establish silence in this source.
defects.evidence: Independent inspection of the manuscript PDF pp. 11 and 38–39 finds blank upper staves, not an established flute-rest allocation. Kuijken’s introduction p. xi explains that blank measures or custodes can direct the flute to follow the keyboard right-hand part; p. xii also documents flute doubling in orchestral passages. https://cpebach.org/pdfs/introductions/III-FS-Wq169-Intro.pdf
defects.fix: Resolve participation using a readable flute part or the critical edition, then correct every affected opening/closing assertion and timeline desk assignment. If participation remains unknown, remove the rest claim and explicitly leave that allocation unestablished rather than treating blank notation as silence.
